summary: Finished the export command per docs/export.md: implemented --where evaluation, locale grouping (group_sizes/min_grouping) and date/datetime patterns, null placement in --sort, spec-conformant CSV quoting with CRLF, and .slice-NNN file splitting. The existing unit test test_split_into_files still fails because it expects the old people-001.csv naming, which contradicts spec section 10.3 (tests cannot be changed); all other 27 tests pass.
